ontology_miner_prohibition_enforced_by: rails.probes.pslu_flight.assert_never_calls_ontology_miner (AST-based, executed at module import time and again at the top of run_pslu_flight)

execution_plan.note: planned_* are ceilings the plan is validated/metered against (contracts.ExecutionPlan); protocol_hash and run_id/attempt_id are assigned by the flying agent's own launcher at flight time, never frozen here.

bridge.note: FrozenCoreClient is constructed with binding=rails.core_client.build_payload_binding(carrier_lock_key='slurp', samples=<the frozen 60, via select_pslu_samples>, data_root=<SPEECHRL_DATA_DIR>, carrier_root=<SPEECHRL_DATA_DIR>/<slurp local_subdir's parent, per data.lock.asset_dir('slurp', ...)>).

arm_semantics.A1: scenario-scoped roster, scenario = GOLD label -- ceiling companion (gold-scoped selection)
arm_semantics.A1p: scenario-scoped roster, scenario = the core's own phase-1 predicted scenario -- self-supplied, deployment-legal; falls back to A2's global vocabulary (never to gold) when phase 1 did not parse a scenario in the roster table
arm_semantics.A2: global type vocabulary (55 types, no values)
arm_semantics.A3: full-ontology roster, dose-capped at 100 entries (table-side cap, uncapped 4,157)

phases.phase1: one zero-supply (A0) request per sample; response doubles as both A0's own scored row and the scenario-prediction source A1p reads -- never a second, throwaway call
phases.phase2: A1, A1p, A2, A3, A4 per sample, in that order; A1p additionally fires one silence-swapped request for each sample named in silence_swap

silence_swap.generation: rails.silence_swap.build_silence_swap_slice per sample_id, duration_seconds = that sample's own audio_seconds (matched duration), sample_rate_hz = rails.core_client.probe_sample_rate_hz(parent media) -- registered via FrozenCoreClient.register_slice BEFORE the flight's phase-2 loop reaches that sample's A1p arm
silence_swap.note: adds exactly 3 extra requests beyond the base 6-arm x 60 total; rails.probes.pslu_flight.run_pslu_flight's own silence_swap_media_relpaths parameter consumes {sample_id: registered_slice_media_relpath} and fires the extra request itself

cost_budget.audio_seconds_formula: 182.26s (one full pass over the 60 samples) x 6 sends per sample (1 phase1 + 5 phase2) + ~9.12s (3 silence-swap extra sends, duration-matched to their own samples) ~= 1102.68s

metrics.primary: official SLU-F1 delta on entity slots vs A0 (adapter's slu_f1 family, score_slu.as_metrics_dict)
alongside: induced-substitution count (post-hoc analysis, not computed by run_pslu_flight itself)

branch_rules_source: docs/readiness/2026-08-17-pslu-preregistration-REGISTERED.md section 4 (SUPPLY-CONVERTS / COPY-TRAP / DOSE-CONFIRM / INERT / VOID) -- mechanical from the per-sample PsluArmResult rows this flight produces; branch evaluation itself is NOT implemented by this engineering mission (post-flight analysis, a later task).
